# proxmox_node_ceph_fs (Resource)

Creates and destroys a CephFS through `/nodes/{node}/ceph/fs/{name}`. Destroy deletes MDS daemons of the filesystem first; if Ceph keeps a daemon in `up:creating`, run `ceph fs fail <name>` before destroying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_fs" "fs" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  name     = "cephfs"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean)
- `pg_num` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `data_pool` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_pool` (String)
